packageRules.description: The shared PKGBUILD manager only captures datasource and depName from the marker comment, so per-package tag formats live here. krb5 has no GitHub releases; tags are krb5-X.Y[.Z]-final.
Stay on the 10.11 LTS series; tags are mariadb-X.Y.Z.

Upstream tags (OPENLDAP_REL_ENG_2_6_16) use underscores, which Renovate cannot turn into the dotted pkgver; track Fedora rawhide, which follows the 2.6 LTS series. Repology returns Fedora's [epoch:]version-release (2.6.16-1.fc46); strip epoch and release.
Stable (even minor) branch only; tags are release-X.Y.Z.
